1.text: Nuko abo bantu uko ari batatu barorera gusubiza Yobu, kuko yari yiyizi yuko ari umukiranutsi.

2.text: Maze uburakari bwa Elihu mwene Barakeli w'Umubuzi wo mu muryango wa Ramu burabyuka, bukongera Yobu kuko yihaye gukiranuka kurusha Imana.

3.text: Kandi arakarira na bagenzi be batatu, kuko batabonye icyo bamusubiza kandi bakagaya Yobu.

4.text: Ariko Elihu yari yarindiriye kuvugana na Yobu, kuko bamurutaga ubukuru.

5.text: Maze Elihu abonye yuko abo bantu babuze icyo bamusubiza, uburakari bwe burabyuka.

6.text: Nuko Elihu mwene Barakeli w'Umubuzi aravuga ati“Ndi muto namwe muri abasaza,Ni cyo cyatumye ntinya,Sintinyuke kubamenyesha icyo nibwira.

7.text: Naravuze nti‘Abafite iminsi ni bo bakwiriye kuvuga,Abamaze imyaka myinshi ni bo bakwiriye kwigisha ubwenge.’

8.text: Ariko mu bantu harimo umwuka,Kandi guhumeka kw'Ishoborabyose ni ko kubaha kujijuka.

9.text: Abakuze si bo bazi ubwenge,N'abasaza si bo bamenya imanza.

10.text: Ni cyo gitumye mvuga nti‘Nimuntegere amatwi,Nanjye mbumvishe icyo nibwira.

11.text: Dore narindiriye amagambo yanyu,Mugitekereza ibyo kuvuga,Ngira ngo nze kumva impamvu zanyu.’

12.text: Ni ukuri nahugukiye kubumva,Ariko nta n'umwe muri mwe wemeje Yobu,Cyangwa ngo amusubize ku byo yavuze.

13.text: Mwitonde kugira ngo mutavuga muti‘Ni twe twaronse ubwenge,Nta muntu wamutsinda yatsindwa n'Imana.’

14.text: Si jye yerekejeho amagambo ye,Nanjye sinamusubiza amagambo nk'ayanyu.

16.text: Mbese mpore kuko nta cyo bavuga,Kuko bahagaze ntibongere gusubiza?

17.text: Jyeho ngiye gusubiza,Ngiye kuvuga icyo ntekereza.

19.text: Dore igituza cyanjye kimeze nka vino idafite aho ibirira,Nk'intango nshya igiye guturika.

20.text: Ngiye kuvuga kugira ngo noroherwe,Ngiye kubumbura akanwa kanjye musubize.

21.text: Ne kurobanura abantu ku butoni,Cyangwa kugira uwo nshyeshya.

22.text: Kuko ntazi gushyeshya,Nashyeshya Umuremyi wanjye yankuraho bidatinze.
